bots.name: 主控/知识架构
bots.purpose: Research intake, ontology/source routing, hypothesis briefs and handoffs; cannot verify its own conclusions.

bots.name: 链上数据
bots.purpose: Real read-only GMGN/RPC/transaction provenance, units, available-at time, provider failure and coverage.

bots.name: 钱包与资金结构
bots.purpose: Wallet roles, capital networks, holding structures, market sequences and non-identity confounders.

bots.name: Alpha与交易经济学
bots.purpose: Discover and preregister hypotheses, OOS predictive increment, executable entry/exit/size/latency/net expectancy.

bots.name: 证据反证审查
bots.purpose: Independent evidence, causal alternative, confounder, leaked-feature, coverage and economic-assumption challenges.

bots.name: 独立QA与回测
bots.purpose: Blind case replay, temporal/group holdout, null controls, test regression and release recommendation.

bots.name: 最终监控
bots.purpose: Only reads human-approved frozen rules and writes source-linked paper-only alerts/abstentions; never authors rules.

rules: Knowledge domains are not Bots and evidence gates are not Bots.
B01 dispatches minimum specialists; does not run all 7 for every task.
B04 cannot validate or release its own Alpha; B05/B06 independently review.
B07 is the only scheduled active monitor; F6 requires human-approved frozen rule.
Bots share one computer, its files, browser sessions and credentials: Bot separation is not a security boundary.
Use per-task directories, isolated branches, single writer/lock for mutable state.
No real trades, signatures, swaps, private keys or broadcast in Phase 1.

staged_rollout.acceptance: Verify original sources, availability, insufficient-data handling.
Use real positive/negative cases, cost tests and independent OOS review.
Deploy human-approved read-only monitor after single-writer/replay/routine tests.
